rss_feeds_articles.headline: What is culture? Look around your dinner table.
rss_feeds_articles.title: What is culture? Look around your dinner table.
rss_feeds_articles.excerpt: What is culture? That is a big question. It trips up a lot of people. Often, we tend to think of high culture when attempting to answer. Art, literature, and the stuff of the academy are what comes to mind. Yes, of course, that is culture and very important culture. But it is not all of culture. There is also folk culture and the ways of your people. That sounds hokey or old-fashioned in our day and age, but it doesn’t need to be, and that is not how it’s meant, at least not in this case. The cake you make because your grandmother used to make it was everyday culture for her, just like the way you and your son go fishing every Friday...
